description: This is a Dart source file defining an ApiService class that facilitates HTTP communication with a backend server. It includes methods for GET, POST, PATCH, and DELETE requests, manages authentication tokens, initializes environment variables, and handles unauthorized responses.

classes.name: ApiService
classes.description: A class providing methods for making authenticated HTTP requests to a backend API, managing tokens and handling error responses.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Loads environment variables and retrieves stored authentication token; prepares the ApiService for use.

methods.name: _getHeaders
methods.description: Constructs HTTP request headers, including the authorization token if available.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Performs a GET request to the specified endpoint, with optional authentication.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Performs a POST request to the specified endpoint with a JSON body, with optional authentication.

methods.name: patch
methods.description: Performs a PATCH request to the specified endpoint with a JSON body, with optional authentication.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Performs a DELETE request to the specified endpoint, with optional authentication.

methods.name: _handleUnauthorized
methods.description: Handles 401 Unauthorized responses by clearing stored tokens and resetting state.
